context.r4_done_detail: src/ocobot/ui/main_window.py _switch_mode captures self._monitor_future before _stop_dynamic_monitor clears it, stops monitoring, creates the new paper provider so the UI can proceed, and routes old-provider teardown through _drain_monitor_future. If the future is already finished/cancelled/errored, teardown occurs immediately; if it is still running after the bounded timeout, teardown is deferred with a done callback until the future completes.
context.r4_impl_note: _monitor_future is a concurrent.futures ThreadPoolExecutor future, not an asyncio future. The implementation therefore uses future.cancel()+future.result(timeout=2.0), and on TimeoutError registers a completion callback instead of closing the provider while the worker is active.
